Equipment:
 Manual Stop Valve (Weld/ 
 Flange End)

This document lists the 
maintenance procedure P1 of manual stop valve, depending on external / internal 
leakage.

The weld end valve used at high pressure circuit super heaters and pre heaters, 
and the Flanged end valves used at low pressure circuit as evaporator, 
economizer.

The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 10 Jan 2004, accepted by General Director 
eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng.. Samir Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of Talkha power station.

A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
Isolate valve mechanically.

Drain the pipeline, which connected to this 
valve.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.

Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.

Check any leakage from gasket between yoke 
 cover and valve body. If it found retighten the bolts.
Check any internal leakage.

Check any leakage from the valve bodies 
 (cracks or mechanical wear). Remark the point of leakage.

Check any leakage form flange end for flange 
 type.

Be sure the valve was out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two 
 end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.

Screw off nut (5) of stud bolts (6), which 
 connected body (1) with yoke cover (2).

Take out from hand wheel (16) all parts of the 
 valve except body.
Take out cone (3) from spindle (4).

Screw off nut (15) and take out hand wheel 
 (16)
Screw off nut (8) of gland bolts (9).

Turn the yoke (2) around spindle (4) until the 
 yoke take out from spindle.
Take out the gland follower (12).
Screws off the retaining screw (13).
Take out yoke sleeve (14) from yoke (2).

Take out the gland packing (10), cooling ring 
 (11).

Screw of nuts of bolts for flange end for 
 flange type valve.

sections.text:
Inspection and Repair of 
all Parts

items:
Check the valves cone (3) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the valves seat (17) and regrind it if 
 needed.

Repair the valve cone (3) and valve seats (17) 
 in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there. ( in 
 weld type the valve end must be cut from the pipe line , in flange type it is 
 easy which flange bolts screwed off only)

Check the Spindle (4) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.

Check the yoke sleeve (14) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.

Checks cooling ring (11) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.

Check the Gland follower (12) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.
Change gasket (7).

Check the body (1) from any cracks or wear by 
 using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using suitable filler 
 material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).
Change gasket for flange end.
If the valve damaged change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1
Clean every part well before any assembly.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence 
 of disassembly.

sections.text:
Replace the Packing of 
valve Gland

items:
Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of 
 shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.

Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using 
 sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with 
 the cut turned 180 , starting at 9 clock.
Tight the gland bolts.

Open and close the valve and be sure that the 
 valve operation is correct.

Technical Procedure
Equipment:
 Manual Stop Valve (Weld/ 
 Flange End)
V 30 121 & V 30 -111
Introduction
This document lists the 
maintenance procedure P1 of manual stop valve, depending on external / internal 
leakage.
The weld end valve used at high pressure circuit super heaters and pre heaters, 
and the Flanged end valves used at low pressure circuit as evaporator, 
economizer.
The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 10 Jan 2004, accepted by General Director 
eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng.. Samir Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of Talkha power station.
Technical Specification
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
Isolate valve mechanically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected to this 
valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried Out
Before Isolated the Valve 
Mechanically
Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.
Check any leakage from gasket between yoke 
 cover and valve body. If it found retighten the bolts.
Check any internal leakage.
Check any leakage from the valve bodies 
 (cracks or mechanical wear). Remark the point of leakage.
Check any leakage form flange end for flange 
 type.
After Isolated the Valve 
Mechanically
Be sure the valve was out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two 
 end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Disassembly the Valve
Screw off nut (5) of stud bolts (6), which 
 connected body (1) with yoke cover (2).
Take out from hand wheel (16) all parts of the 
 valve except body.
Take out cone (3) from spindle (4).
Screw off nut (15) and take out hand wheel 
 (16)
Screw off nut (8) of gland bolts (9).
Turn the yoke (2) around spindle (4) until the 
 yoke take out from spindle.
Take out the gland follower (12).
Screws off the retaining screw (13).
Take out yoke sleeve (14) from yoke (2).
Take out the gland packing (10), cooling ring 
 (11).
Screw of nuts of bolts for flange end for 
 flange type valve.
Inspection and Repair of 
all Parts
Check the valves cone (3) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.
Check the valves seat (17) and regrind it if 
 needed.
Repair the valve cone (3) and valve seats (17) 
 in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there. ( in 
 weld type the valve end must be cut from the pipe line , in flange type it is 
 easy which flange bolts screwed off only)
Check the Spindle (4) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.
Check the yoke sleeve (14) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Checks cooling ring (11) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Check the Gland follower (12) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.
Change gasket (7).
Check the body (1) from any cracks or wear by 
 using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using suitable filler 
 material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).
Change gasket for flange end.
If the valve damaged change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1
Assembly of Valve
Clean every part well before any assembly.
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence 
 of disassembly.
Replace the Packing of 
valve Gland
Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.
Wire the suitable packing size on a part of 
 shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.
Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using 
 sharp knife.
Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with

Tight the gland bolts.
Open and close the valve and be sure that the

If 
you need any help please go to the operating instruction for repairs and 
maintenance D-4.
Put the valve into operation and check the 
list of checking before isolated.
